categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet transaction creation logic in src/wallet/spend.cpp and src/wallet/feebumper.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents fee-bumped transactions from having an older nLockTime than the transaction they replace, eliminating an unnatural on-chain fingerprint identifying Bitcoin Core wallets. The wallet rubric highlights privacy in transaction creation (fingerprinting), though the problem is reasonably deferrable as the issue only affects a small fraction of RBF transactions.
